lines.en: I haven't moved a single step.
My base is fixed to the floor.

lines.zh: 我被推到展位的另一头。
lines.en: I get wheeled to the other end.
The wheels squeal on the tiles.
One of my ears got knocked askew.

lines.zh: 紫色的毛蹭掉了一点漆。
lines.en: A little paint rubbed off my purple fur.
I slide half a tile and stop.
A latch groaned once.
I'm set straight, facing the corridor.

lines.zh: 墙上映出我长长的影子。
lines.en: My long shadow falls on the wall.
I slide along, very slowly.
The guitar on my back sways.
I stop beside a display case.

lines.zh: 地砖被我推得发出响声。
lines.en: I push the tiles into a clatter.
I'm pushed back against the corner.
I wobble twice as I stop.
I stand holding my guitar.
My long ears hang on both sides.
By day I'm not much for moving.
My bow tie is red.
My eyes look down the corridor.
A light hum moves inside me.

lines.zh: 我的毛上有孩子的手印。
lines.en: There are small handprints in my fur.
I don't blink, nor do I need to.
The sign says welcome.
I hear music far away.
I stand by the wall without moving.
The counter light reaches my feet.
My ear touches the lampshade.
This standing lasts all day.

lines.zh: 我怀里很空，什么也没有。
lines.en: My arms hold nothing at all.
I wait for someone at the door.
You look up at my ears.
I'm quite a bit taller than you.
My hands are empty but for the guitar.
You're standing a bit too close.

lines.zh: 我的咧嘴笑是画上去的。
lines.en: My grin is painted on.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了好一会儿。
lines.en: We look at each other a while.
You smell faintly of biscuits.
I know that uniform.

lines.zh: 你不是这里的工作人员。
lines.en: You're not staff here.
Can you play the guitar?
My ears can twitch a little.
Wait until closing time.
My purple shell has a dent.
A dull clang made my ears twitch.
I'm standing, though crooked.
Some parts inside came loose.
My smile is still that same smile.
That sound was sickeningly hollow.
I shifted half a step sideways.
You've left a sign on my shell.
Repairs will take a while.
I don't eat, really.
Even if you gave it, I couldn't catch it.
That's a snack for the guests.
Just leave it on the counter.
My mouth is stuffed with cotton.
You're holding it up to tease me.
I don't even have a tongue.
You look hungrier than I am.
Don't drop crumbs at my feet.
That smell reaches down the corridor.
Smiling like this is rather awkward.
That thing is worth more than I am.
I won't move an inch for it.
Thanks for thinking of me.
Bring something else next time.

lines.zh: 我的紫色外皮被撞得响了一声。
lines.en: My purple shell rang out from the bump.
My base is heavier than you'd think.
The hard shell shoved you back.
My guitar knocked against the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我耳朵乱摆。
lines.en: The blow set my ears swinging.
I'm blocking this aisle.
Please walk around me.
A latch gave out one clack.
The tiles rang from our impact.
You'd better stop pushing.

lines.zh: 我只是摆在走廊的玩偶。
lines.en: I'm only a doll set in the corridor.

lines.zh: 我需要的是电池，不是这些。
lines.en: I need batteries, not that.

lines.zh: 两个展品并排站着罢了。
lines.en: Just two display pieces side by side.
Your ears are shorter than mine.
We'll just keep looking at each other.
Don't knock the guitar over.
At closing, we each go back.
We look respectable enough like this.
I can't even nod.
I can't bend down to pick it up.
It rolled up to my feet.
Someone put it into my hands.
I'm holding it, but feel nothing.
This coin looks old.
It's stuck between my fingers.
I've no way to put it down.
It's lying right at my feet.
I'll wait for the guest to claim it.
A floor tile stopped it.
Someone has undone my latches.
My ears have turned toward the sound.
Half the corridor lights went out.
I'm no longer on my display spot.
You're standing in my aisle.
There's no one else on this floor.
My smile hasn't changed.
The wheels have started turning.
You've run to the end of the corridor.
I'm following you slowly.
I slide along the base of the wall.
My ear reaches the corner first.
Do you hear the wheels?
This corridor only opens at one end.
I've lowered my guitar.
Your breathing is a little uneven.
I'm waiting at the corner.
One more shuffle and I'd reach you.
I slam my whole body into you.
The guitar sweeps across.

lines.zh: 我用手肘把你别在过道里。
lines.en: I pin you in the aisle with my elbow.
That one landed with real weight.
My wrist turned stiffly.
You blocked it, but with effort.
My ear lashes your shoulder.
You've taken a step back.
The tiles made a loud crack.
I'm still standing in the aisle.
I've been set at the corridor's corner.
The lamp lights up my purple shell.
The sign overhead just lit up.
Someone's footsteps are approaching.
I raise my ears upright.
The floor is cold as iron.
A row of old posters hangs on the wall.

lines.zh: 展示位的灯打在我蓝毛上。
lines.en: The display lamp falls on my blue fur.
There's no one in the corridor.
Someone has opened the door.
The fire scorched my fur.

lines.zh: 摔下去时吉他的弦断了。
lines.en: The guitar's strings snapped as I fell.
Water pours in through my ear.

lines.zh: 气浪把外壳掀开一道口。
lines.en: The blast cracked my shell open.
A shot buried itself in my chest.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的关节僵住。
lines.en: That light froze my joints.

lines.zh: 我是电池驱动的，不会饿。
lines.en: I run on batteries; I can't starve.
The current ran from my ears to my feet.
I still hold the guitar as I fall.
